params.prompt: Recompose this square game key art into a wide 16:9 landscape cover banner for a game portfolio. Keep the exact same game logo lettering, spelling, colors and style, the same characters and the same art style, lighting and palette. Extend the scene naturally to the left and right so it fills the wide frame - no letterboxing, no borders, no extra text, no watermark. Place the logo clearly readable and fully inside the frame with comfortable margins, with the hero subject beside it. Scene: PropBet - a bright sky of fluffy clouds and floating cliff islands with waterfalls, the 'PROPBET' gold-and-silver logo with 'RACE THE ODDS' under it, the red and blue plane flying through the golden multiplier ring marked 1x 2x 5x 10x 25x 50x, and the yellow 'CRASH' burst.
